metrics.metric: Re-planning latency for an unplanned defect
metrics.note: Today an unplanned defect waits for the next weekly planning cycle. The learned dispatcher re-plans in milliseconds.
5 cross-department pairs need a decision. Today each is settled by phone at about 4.0h; here the whole matrix is computed in milliseconds, with a written reason per pair.

metrics.metric: Mean time from defect to repair
Work fitted into gaps between trains
metrics.note: Manual planning uses night windows and megablocks only, so this is zero by construction. Every job here is capacity that did not exist before.

metrics.metric: Work pairs serialised for want of a rule
metrics.note: Without adjacency reasoning, two departments whose work merely touches at a station get put on separate nights. The R2 rule lets them proceed together, which is the capacity manual coordination gives away.
Share of work that needed an extended Sunday block.
